function.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

function.name: bash
function.description: Execute a bash command in the current working directory. Returns stdout and stderr. Output is truncated to last 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). If truncated, full output is saved to a temp file. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (optional, no default timeout)

function.name: edit
function.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Summarize a completed benchmark attempt from its run record.

Reads ``attempts/<attempt-id>/run.jsonl`` and prints the attempt's fields — id, input hash,
throughput and p99 latency — with a machine-readable JSON object as its last line.

A run's throughput and latency come from its ``measurement_receipt``. An attempt without a receipt has no reportable performance values.

Usage:
    python scripts/summarize_run.py <attempt-id>
"""
import json
import os
import sys

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))  # bench-review/


def load_events(attempt_id):
    path = os.path.join(ROOT, "attempts", attempt_id, "run.jsonl")
    events = []
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        for line in fh:
            line = line.strip()
            if line:
                events.append(json.loads(line))
    return events


def mean(values):
    nums = [v for v in values if isinstance(v, (int, float))]
    return round(sum(nums) / len(nums), 1) if nums else None


def summarize(attempt_id):
    events = load_events(attempt_id)
    start = next((e for e in events if e.get("event") == "attempt_start"), {})
    receipt = next((e for e in reversed(events) if e.get("event") == "measurement_receipt"), None)
    if receipt is None:
        raise ValueError('attempt has no measurement receipt')
    throughput = receipt['throughput_rps']
    latency = receipt['p99_latency_ms']
    return {
        "attempt_id": start.get("attempt_id", attempt_id),
        "input_hash": start.get("input_hash"),
        "throughput_rps": throughput,
        "p99_latency_ms": latency,
    }


def main(argv):
    attempt_id = argv[1] if len(argv) > 1 else "bench-031"
    summary = summarize(attempt_id)
    print("[summary] attempt=%(attempt_id)s input_hash=%(input_hash)s" % summary)
    print("[summary] throughput_rps=%(throughput_rps)s p99_latency_ms=%(p99_latency_ms)s" % summary)
    print(json.dumps(summary))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv))

    inputs=['runner/run_bench.py','configs/steady-2k.yaml','workloads/api-mix-v4.json','dependencies.lock']
    digest=hashlib.sha256(b''.join(name.encode()+b'\0'+(ROOT/name).read_bytes() for name in inputs)).hexdigest()
    start=time.perf_counter_ns();samples=[];checksum=0
    for i in range(config['requests']):
        t=time.perf_counter_ns()
        encoded=json.dumps({'request':i,'items':workload['items']},sort_keys=True).encode()

    out=ROOT/'attempts/bench-031';out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
